ticket.title: Ingestion write path — tracer-bullet vertical slice
ticket.observable_behavior: A single record submitted at the ingestion entry point travels the full write path end-to-end, however thin: it is accepted, transformed into the resolved schema shape, durably persisted in the resolved storage engine, and can be read back with every field intact and matching what was submitted. One successful write-then-readback of a real record through every layer of the slice is the proof; a stubbed or mocked persistence layer does not count, because the slice exists to exercise the resolved storage-engine and schema-shape decisions against reality.
ticket.invalidating_decision: storage-engine — reversal of the resolved engine choice would obsolete the entire write path this ticket builds (a reversal of schema-shape would likewise force a rewrite of the persisted format); recorded so the loss is traceable rather than silent if either resolution is revisited.
